# Children's app prompt customization (2025-12-13 19:54Z)

_**User (2025-12-13 01:22Z)**_

review app and help me think through a new capability / feature that would allow more prompt customization on the outputs? Right now the reference images are forcing output to always have the border - and that's not giving us enough variety - maybe the settings panel would give users the ability to adjust parameters that influence the prompts or even write their own inputs. Just ideation at this point in time. Keeping in mind it's an app for children.

(if server doesn't support)\n- If style selected, add to &#96;freeTextDescription&#96;:\n  - Example: \"Style: Crayon\" or \"Medium: Watercolor\"\n- Server will include this in prompt generation\n\n**Recommendation:** Start with client-side approach (simpler), move to server-side later if needed.\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Order (Do One Step at a Time)\n\n1. ✅ **Phase 1** - View mode infrastructure (enum, state, persistence)\n2. ✅ **Phase 2** - Settings UI (view selector)\n3. ✅ **Phase 3** - Style carousel data (placeholder ingredients)\n4. ✅ **Phase 4** - New view layout (FourCarouselView)\n5. ✅ **Phase 5** - Generation integration (4th reference image)\n6. ✅ **Phase 6** - Prompt modification (style in prompt)\n\n---",

        "contents": "### Phase 5: Generation Integration (4th Reference Image)\n\n#### Step 5.1: Update startImageGeneration() Logic\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- In &#96;startImageGeneration()&#96;:\n  - Check &#96;viewMode&#96;\n  - If &#96;.fourCarousel&#96;:\n    - Require &#96;styleIndex &gt;= 0&#96;\n    - Get selected style ingredient\n    - Add style reference image to &#96;referenceImageIds&#96; array\n  - If &#96;.default&#96;:\n    - Use existing 3-image logic (unchanged)\n\n#### Step 5.2: Handle Style Reference Image\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- For placeholder styles (no actual image):\n  - Option A: Skip 4th reference image (just use style name in prompt)\n  - Option B: Create a placeholder image asset for each style\n  - **Recommendation:** Start with Option A (simpler), add images later if needed\n\n---\n\n### Phase 6: Prompt Modification (Style Integration)\n\n#### Step 6.1: Update Server-Side Prompt Generation\n**File:** &#96;Abbies World Server/src/game_engine.py&#96;\n- Check if 4th reference image is provided\n- If yes, extract style name from image path or metadata\n- Modify prompt generation to include style instruction:\n  - Example: \"Render in [STYLE] style: [generated prompt]\"\n  - Or: \"Using [STYLE] medium, create: [generated prompt]\"\n\n#### Step 6.2: Alternative: Client-Side Style Prompt\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96; (if server doesn't support)\n- If style selected, add to &#96;freeTextDescription&#96;:\n  - Example: \"Style: Crayon\" or \"Medium: Watercolor\"\n- Server will include this in prompt generation\n\n**Recommendation:** Start with client-side approach (simpler), move to server-side later if needed.\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Order (Do One Step at a Time)\n\n1. ✅ **Phase 1** - View mode infrastructure (enum, state, persistence)\n2. ✅ **Phase 2** - Settings UI (view selector)\n3. ✅ **Phase 3** - Style carousel data (placeholder ingredients)\n4. ✅ **Phase 4** - New view layout (FourCarouselView)\n5. ✅ **Phase 5** - Generation integration (4th reference image)\n6. ✅ **Phase 6** - Prompt modification (style in prompt)\n\n---",

        "contents": "    }\n    \n    private var gridView: some View {\n        VStack {\n            Text(\"All Memories from the Adventure ✨\")\n                .font(.system(size: 24, weight: .bold))\n                .foregroundColor(.white)\n                .padding(.top, 50)\n            \n            ScrollView {\n                LazyVGrid(columns: Array(repeating: GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: 20), count: 5), spacing: 20) {\n                    ForEach(0..&lt;viewModel.gameState.polaroidImages.count, id: \\.self) { index in\n                        if viewModel.gameState.polaroidImages.indices.contains(index) {\n                            Image(uiImage: viewModel.gameState.polaroidImages[index])\n                                .resizable()\n                                .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fit)\n                                .frame(width: 200, height: 250)\n                                .border(Color.white, width: 8)\n                                .background(Color.white)\n                                .padding(.bottom, 40) // Polaroid frame effect\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                .padding()\n            }\n            \n            Spacer()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private var finalCoverView: some View {\n        VStack {\n            if let coverImage = viewModel.gameState.coverImage {\n                Image(uiImage: coverImage)\n                    .resizable()\n                    .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fit)\n                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)\n                    .padding()\n                    .opacity(showFinalCover ? 1 : 0)\n                    .animation(.easeIn(duration: 3), value: showFinalCover)\n            }\n            \n            Button(\"Close\") {\n                onDismiss?()\n            }\n            .padding()\n            .background(Color.blue)\n            .foregroundColor(.white)\n            .cornerRadius(8)\n            .padding(.bottom, 50)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    \n    // MARK: - Sequence Control\n    ",

        "contents": "    private func processBuggyImage(_ image: UIImage) -&gt; UIImage? {\n        guard let cgImage = image.cgImage else { return image }\n        \n        let width = cgImage.width\n        let height = cgImage.height\n        let colorSpace = CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB()\n        let bytesPerPixel = 4\n        let bytesPerRow = bytesPerPixel * width\n        let bitsPerComponent = 8\n        \n        guard let context = CGContext(\n            data: nil,\n            width: width,\n            height: height,\n            bitsPerComponent: bitsPerComponent,\n            bytesPerRow: bytesPerRow,\n            space: colorSpace,\n            bitmapInfo: CGImageAlphaInfo.premultipliedLast.rawValue\n        ) else {\n            return image\n        }\n        \n        context.draw(cgImage, in: CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: width, height: height))\n        \n        guard let pixelData = context.data else { return image }\n        let data = pixelData.assumingMemoryBound(to: UInt8.self)\n        \n        // Get top-left pixel color (background color to remove)\n        let bgR = Int(data[0])\n        let bgG = Int(data[1])\n        let bgB = Int(data[2])\n        \n        // Make matching pixels transparent (within 30 RGB tolerance)\n        for y in 0..&lt;height {\n            for x in 0..&lt;width {\n                let pixelIndex = (y * width + x) * bytesPerPixel\n                let r = Int(data[pixelIndex])\n                let g = Int(data[pixelIndex + 1])\n                let b = Int(data[pixelIndex + 2])\n                \n                if abs(r - bgR) &lt; 30 &amp;&amp; abs(g - bgG) &lt; 30 &amp;&amp; abs(b - bgB) &lt; 30 {\n                    data[pixelIndex + 3] = 0 // Make transparent\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        \n        guard let processedCGImage = context.makeImage() else { return image }\n        return UIImage(cgImage: processedCGImage)\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Waypoint Click Handling\n    \n    func handleWaypointClick(at point: CGPoint, canvasSize: CGSize) {\n        guard !gameState.gameComplete else { return }\n        ",

        "contents": "struct PolaroidView: View {\n    let image: UIImage\n    let index: Int\n    let isVisible: Bool\n    let currentIndex: Int\n    let totalCount: Int\n    \n    private var offset: PolaroidOffset {\n        let polaroidOffset = (index - currentIndex + totalCount) % totalCount\n        let stackOffset = min(polaroidOffset, 5)\n        \n        return PolaroidOffset(\n            x: Double(stackOffset * 5),\n            y: Double(stackOffset * 3),\n            scale: 1.0 - Double(stackOffset) * 0.05,\n            rotation: Double(stackOffset * 2),\n            opacity: max(0.3, 1.0 - Double(stackOffset) * 0.15),\n            zIndex: 100 - Double(polaroidOffset)\n        )\n    }\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        Image(uiImage: image)\n            .resizable()\n            .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fit)\n            .frame(width: 600, height: 600)\n            .border(Color.white, width: 8)\n            .background(Color.white)\n            .padding(.bottom, 40) // Polaroid frame effect\n            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.8), radius: 16)\n            .offset(x: isVisible ? offset.x : 0, y: isVisible ? offset.y : -100)\n            .scaleEffect(isVisible ? offset.scale : 0.3)\n            .rotationEffect(.degrees(isVisible ? offset.rotation : 180))\n            .opacity(isVisible ? offset.opacity : 0)\n            .zIndex(offset.zIndex)\n            .animation(isVisible ? .spring(response: 1.2, dampingFraction: 0.4) : nil, value: isVisible)\n            .animation(.spring(response: 0.5, dampingFraction: 0.8), value: currentIndex)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct PolaroidOffset: Equatable {\n    let x: Double\n    let y: Double\n    let scale: Double\n    let rotation: Double\n    let opacity: Double\n    let zIndex: Double\n    \n    static func == (lhs: PolaroidOffset, rhs: PolaroidOffset) -&gt; Bool {\n        lhs.x == rhs.x &amp;&amp; lhs.y == rhs.y &amp;&amp; lhs.scale == rhs.scale &amp;&amp;\n        lhs.rotation == rhs.rotation &amp;&amp; lhs.opacity == rhs.opacity &amp;&amp; lhs.zIndex == rhs.zIndex\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "**Implementation Quality:**\n- Logic is clear and correct\n- Error handling is good\n- State management is proper\n\n### ✅ **Victory Sequence**\n\n**Status:** Fully implemented (per &#96;VictorySequenceView.swift&#96;)\n\n**Phases:**\n1. ✅ Initial victory image (4 seconds)\n2. ✅ Cutscene (4 seconds, fade in/out)\n3. ✅ Polaroid entrance (staggered, 6.2s per polaroid)\n4. ✅ Interactive carousel (auto-advance + manual tap)\n5. ✅ Grid view (5-column layout)\n6. ✅ Final cover image (fade in)\n\n**Note:** Previous assessment documents suggested this was incomplete, but the current code shows full implementation.\n\n### 🟡 **Minor Issues**\n\n1. **Path Lines - Dashed Pattern**\n   - Current: Solid green lines\n   - Spec: Dashed pattern &#96;[5, 5]&#96;\n   - Impact: Visual only, doesn't affect gameplay\n   - Priority: Low (cosmetic)\n\n2. **Screen Shake Animation**\n   - Implementation exists (&#96;ShakeEffect&#96; modifier)\n   - May need visual verification\n   - Priority: Low (test and adjust if needed)\n\n3. **Image Processing on Main Thread**\n   - &#96;processBuggyImage()&#96; does pixel-level processing\n   - Could block UI for large images\n   - Priority: Medium (move to background queue)\n\n---\n\n## Performance Review\n\n### ✅ **Good Practices**\n\n1. **Image Caching**\n   - &#96;ImageCache&#96; service prevents redundant downloads\n   - Proper async/await usage\n\n2. **Asset Loading**\n   - Critical assets load first\n   - Victory assets load in background\n   - Graceful degradation if assets fail\n\n3. **Animation Performance**\n   - Uses SpriteKit (hardware-accelerated)\n   - 60fps target for smooth animations\n\n### 🟡 **Performance Concerns**\n\n1. **Buggy Image Processing**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n   // WaypointGameViewModel.swift:274-322\n   private func processBuggyImage(_ image: UIImage) -&gt; UIImage?\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   - Processes pixels on main thread\n   - Could cause frame drops for large images\n   - **Fix:** Move to background queue\n\n2. **Waypoint Click Detection**\n   - O(n) search through all waypoints\n   - Fine for 19 waypoints, but could optimize",

        "contents": "//\n//  StylePlaceholderTile.swift\n//  abbies.world.ios\n//\n//  Placeholder tile for style carousel items (no image available)\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct StylePlaceholderTile: View {\n    let styleName: String\n    let shortDescription: String? // Optional: 1-4 word description overlay\n    \n    // MARK: - TEMPORARY FEATURE\n    // This description overlay is TEMPORARY until we have actual style assets.\n    // To remove: Delete the shortDescription parameter and the description overlay VStack below.\n    // The styleName at the bottom should remain.\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        ZStack {\n            // Dark blue background\n            Color(red: 0.1, green: 0.2, blue: 0.4)\n                .cornerRadius(12)\n            \n            // Light blue architectural/geometric lines\n            GeometryReader { geometry in\n                Path { path in\n                    let width = geometry.size.width\n                    let height = geometry.size.height\n                    \n                    // Horizontal lines\n                    for i in 1..&lt;4 {\n                        let y = height * CGFloat(i) / 4\n                        path.move(to: CGPoint(x: 0, y: y))\n                        path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: width, y: y))\n                    }\n                    \n                    // Vertical lines\n                    for i in 1..&lt;4 {\n                        let x = width * CGFloat(i) / 4\n                        path.move(to: CGPoint(x: x, y: 0))\n                        path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: x, y: height))\n                    }\n                    \n                    // Diagonal lines (architectural feel)\n                    path.move(to: CGPoint(x: 0, y: 0))\n                    path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: width, y: height))\n                    path.move(to: CGPoint(x: width, y: 0))\n                    path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: 0, y: height))\n                }\n                .stroke(Color(red: 0.4, green: 0.6, blue: 0.9), lineWidth: 1.5)\n            }\n            \n            // TEMPORARY: Short description overlay (top center)",

        "contents": "    \n    // MARK: - Create Image\n    \n    func createImage(request: CreateRequest) -&gt; AnyPublisher&lt;URLSession.DataTaskPublisher.Output, Error&gt; {\n        guard let url = URL(string: \"\\(baseURL)/api/create\") else {\n            return Fail(error: URLError(.badURL))\n                .eraseToAnyPublisher()\n        }\n        \n        var urlRequest = URLRequest(url: url)\n        urlRequest.httpMethod = \"POST\"\n        urlRequest.setValue(\"application/json\", forHTTPHeaderField: \"Content-Type\")\n        \n        // Add API key header if available\n        ServerConfig.shared.addAPIKeyHeader(to: &amp;urlRequest)\n        \n        do {\n            urlRequest.httpBody = try JSONEncoder().encode(request)\n        } catch {\n            return Fail(error: error)\n                .eraseToAnyPublisher()\n        }\n        \n        return URLSession.shared.dataTaskPublisher(for: urlRequest)\n            .mapError { $0 as Error }\n            .eraseToAnyPublisher()\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Helper\n    \n    private func request&lt;T: Decodable&gt;(url: String, method: String) -&gt; AnyPublisher&lt;T, Error&gt; {\n        guard let url = URL(string: url) else {\n            return Fail(error: URLError(.badURL))\n                .eraseToAnyPublisher()\n        }\n        \n        var urlRequest = URLRequest(url: url)\n        urlRequest.httpMethod = method\n        \n        // Add API key header if available\n        ServerConfig.shared.addAPIKeyHeader(to: &amp;urlRequest)\n        \n        return URLSession.shared.dataTaskPublisher(for: urlRequest)\n            .map(\\.data)\n            .decode(type: T.self, decoder: JSONDecoder())\n            .eraseToAnyPublisher()\n    }\n}",

(self-contained)\n  - [ ] Create &#96;{GameName}Models.swift&#96;\n  - [ ] Create &#96;{GameName}AudioService.swift&#96; (if needed)\n  \n- [ ] **Identify all assets**\n  - [ ] Background images\n  - [ ] Sprite images\n  - [ ] UI elements\n  - [ ] Audio files (if any)\n  \n- [ ] **Organize assets**\n  - [ ] Create server directory structure\n  - [ ] Upload assets to server\n  - [ ] Verify asset URLs\n  \n- [ ] **Update asset references**\n  - [ ] Update Swift code to use server URLs\n  - [ ] Use ImageCache service (already exists)\n  - [ ] Handle asset loading errors gracefully\n  \n- [ ] **Test standalone**\n  - [ ] Uncomment &#96;@main&#96; in standalone app\n  - [ ] Comment &#96;@main&#96; in main app\n  - [ ] Test game runs independently\n  \n- [ ] **Test integration**\n  - [ ] Add to MainView with &#96;fullScreenCover&#96;\n  - [ ] Test with callbacks\n  - [ ] Verify works in main app context\n\n### Asset Naming Conventions\n\n**Current Phaser:** &#96;assets/images/objects/0.png&#96;  \n**Swift Server:** &#96;/static/assets/minigames/find_princess/objects/0.png&#96;\n\n**Pattern:**\n- Use snake_case for game names: &#96;find_princess&#96;, &#96;goonpopper&#96;, &#96;tracer3&#96;\n- Keep original asset names\n- Organize by type: &#96;backgrounds/&#96;, &#96;objects/&#96;, &#96;ui/&#96;, &#96;sounds/&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Priority Matrix\n\n| Game | Kid Appeal | Complexity | Port Time | Priority |\n|------|-----------|-----------|-----------|----------|\n| goonpopper | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Low-Med | 4-6h | **HIGH** |\n| FindPrincess | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | 6-8h | **HIGH** |\n| FindCarnival | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | 4-6h | **HIGH** |\n| FindJungle | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | 4-6h | Medium |\n| FindFarm | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | 4-6h | Medium |\n| FindPirates | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | 4-6h | Medium |\n| puzzle | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | 6-8h | Medium |\n| FindSpace | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | 4-6h | Medium* |\n| enchantedforest | ⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | 8-10h | Low |",

        "contents": "# Drawer Migration Plan: Two-Column to Full-Width with Overlay Drawer\n\n**Date:** December 2025  \n**Goal:** Migrate from 55%/45% split layout to full-width carousels with right-side overlay drawer\n\n---\n\n## Current State Analysis\n\n### Current Structure\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nMainView\n├── HStack (spacing: 0)\n│   ├── CombinedColumnView (55% width)\n│   │   └── 3 Carousels (Friend, Outfit, Place)\n│   └── RightColumnView (45% width)\n│       ├── Preview Section\n│       └── History Section\n└── Overlay (Settings/Games buttons, error dialogs)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Dependencies\n- &#96;RightColumnCalculations&#96; depends on &#96;LeftColumnCalculations&#96; for height matching\n- &#96;CombinedColumnView&#96; uses &#96;LeftColumnCalculations&#96; for carousel heights\n- Both views share the same &#96;GeometryReader&#96; context\n\n### Key Components to Modify\n1. **MainView.swift** - Layout structure (HStack → ZStack)\n2. **CombinedColumnView** - Width constraint (55% → 100%)\n3. **RightColumnView** - Convert to drawer content\n4. **New: DrawerView** - Drawer container with handle\n5. **New: DrawerHandle** - Semi-transparent handle component\n\n---\n\n## Migration Strategy: Incremental &amp; Safe\n\n### Phase 1: Foundation (Low Risk)\n**Goal:** Set up drawer structure without breaking existing layout\n\n#### Step 1.1: Create Drawer State Management\n- **File:** &#96;MainView.swift&#96;\n- **Action:** Add &#96;@State private var isDrawerOpen: Bool = false&#96;\n- **Risk:** None (new state, doesn't affect existing code)\n- **Test:** Verify app still runs normally\n\n#### Step 1.2: Create DrawerHandle Component\n- **File:** &#96;Views/Components/DrawerHandle.swift&#96; (new file)\n- **Action:** Create reusable drawer handle view\n- **Properties:**\n  - Semi-transparent background (30-40% opacity)\n  - Chevron icon (left-pointing when closed, right-pointing when open)\n  - Rounded rectangle shape\n  - Tap gesture to toggle drawer\n  - Subtle pulse animation when closed\n- **Risk:** None (new component, not integrated yet)\n- **Test:** Can instantiate and display in preview",

        "contents": "//\n//  GoonPopperModels.swift\n//  abbies.world.ios\n//\n//  Created for Goon Popper Minigame\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport CoreGraphics\nimport UIKit\nimport SpriteKit\nimport Combine\n\n// MARK: - Goon State\n\nenum GoonState {\n    case active      // Bouncing around\n    case popped      // Falling down, stopped moving\n}\n\n// MARK: - Goon Model\n\nclass GoonNode: SKSpriteNode {\n    let goonIndex: Int\n    var state: GoonState = .active\n    var isMoving: Bool = true\n    \n    init(texture: SKTexture, goonIndex: Int) {\n        self.goonIndex = goonIndex\n        super.init(texture: texture, color: .white, size: texture.size())\n    }\n    \n    required init?(coder aDecoder: NSCoder) {\n        fatalError(\"init(coder:) has not been implemented\")\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Game State\n\nclass GoonPopperGameState: ObservableObject {\n    @Published var gameStarted: Bool = false\n    @Published var gameOver: Bool = false\n    @Published var elapsedTime: TimeInterval = 0\n    @Published var startTime: Date?\n    @Published var goonsPopped: Int = 0\n    @Published var totalGoons: Int = 13\n    \n    // Asset images\n    @Published var backgroundImage: UIImage?\n    @Published var goonImages: [UIImage] = []\n    @Published var playButtonImage: UIImage?\n    \n    // Selected background index (1-3)\n    @Published var selectedBackgroundIndex: Int = 1\n    \n    // Computed properties\n    var allGoonsPopped: Bool {\n        goonsPopped &gt;= totalGoons\n    }\n    \n    var formattedTime: String {\n        let minutes = Int(elapsedTime) / 60\n        let seconds = Int(elapsedTime) % 60\n        let milliseconds = Int((elapsedTime.truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: 1)) * 1000)\n        return String(format: \"%02d:%02d.%03d\", minutes, seconds, milliseconds)\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "# Minigame Ideas for Abbies World\n\nThis document outlines creative minigame concepts that utilize user-generated images and characters from the app.\n\n---\n\n## 🎮 Implemented Games\n\n### 1. Memory/Concentration Game ✅\n**Status:** Implemented  \n**Location:** &#96;Views/Minigames/MemoryGame/&#96;\n\n**Description:**\n- Classic memory game using user-generated images\n- Players match pairs of their created images\n- Three difficulty levels (Easy: 4 pairs, Medium: 6 pairs, Hard: 8 pairs)\n- Score based on number of moves\n- Beautiful card-flip animations\n\n**Features:**\n- Uses images from user's generation history\n- Automatically creates pairs from available images\n- Tracks moves and score\n- Victory screen with statistics\n\n---\n\n## 💡 Additional Game Ideas\n\n### 2. Character Scene Builder 🎨\n**Type:** Creative/Storytelling  \n**Complexity:** Medium  \n**Kid Appeal:** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐\n\n**Description:**\nPlayers create scenes using their generated characters and backgrounds. Drag and drop characters into different scenes, add props, and create stories.\n\n**Mechanics:**\n- Select a background (from user's \"place\" images or generated backgrounds)\n- Drag characters into the scene\n- Position and resize characters\n- Add text bubbles for dialogue\n- Save scenes as new images\n- Share scenes with others\n\n**Technical Implementation:**\n- Use SwiftUI drag-and-drop\n- Canvas-based rendering (similar to WaypointGameCanvas)\n- Image composition to create final scene\n- Save composed images back to server\n\n**Assets Needed:**\n- User's character images (from \"friends\" carousel)\n- Background images (from \"places\" carousel)\n- Optional: Prop/object images\n\n---\n\n### 3. Character Matching Game 🎯\n**Type:** Matching/Puzzle  \n**Complexity:** Low-Medium  \n**Kid Appeal:** ⭐⭐⭐⭐\n\n**Description:**\nMatch characters to their outfits, or match characters to the places they belong in. Multiple game modes.\n\n**Game Modes:**\n1. **Outfit Match:** Match character to their outfit\n2. **Place Match:** Match character to their place\n3. **Style Match:** Match character to their art style",

        "contents": "# Documentation\n\nThis folder contains all project documentation organized by category.\n\n## Structure\n\n### 📋 [current-state/](./current-state/)\nDocuments that describe **what is** - current implementations, completed features, and existing patterns.\n\n### 🔮 [future-plans/](./future-plans/)\nDocuments that describe **what could be** - plans, ideas, suggestions, and potential future features.\n\n### 🔧 [problem-solving/](./problem-solving/)\nDocuments that describe **one-time problem solving** or processes - risk analyses, troubleshooting guides, and process documentation used to set the stage for conversations.\n\n## Quick Reference\n\n**Current State:**\n- &#96;DRAWER_IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md&#96; - Drawer feature implementation details\n- &#96;MUSIC_IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md&#96; - Music playback system implementation\n- &#96;PROJECT_REVIEW.md&#96; - Overall project review and assessment\n- &#96;STANDALONE_MINIGAME_PATTERN.md&#96; - Pattern for standalone minigame architecture\n\n**Future Plans:**\n- &#96;DRAWER_MIGRATION_PLAN.md&#96; - Drawer migration plan (completed, kept for reference)\n- &#96;MINIGAME_IDEAS.md&#96; - Ideas for new minigames\n- &#96;MUSIC_COORDINATION_PLAN.md&#96; - Music service coordination strategy\n- &#96;MUSIC_PLAYBACK_PLAN.md&#96; - Music playback implementation plan\n- &#96;PHASER_MINIGAMES_PORTING_PLAN.md&#96; - Plan for porting Phaser games to Swift\n- &#96;VIEW_MODE_PLAN.md&#96; - View mode system implementation plan\n- &#96;VOICE_INTEGRATION_SUGGESTIONS.md&#96; - Voice narration opportunities\n\n**Problem Solving:**\n- &#96;MUSIC_PLAYBACK_RISKS.md&#96; - Risk analysis for music playback\n- &#96;SERVER_CHANGES_PROCESS.md&#96; - Process for handling server changes",

        "contents": "# Project Review: Abbie's World iOS - Waypoint Navigation Game\n\n**Date:** December 2025  \n**Project Type:** Swift iOS Game for Kids  \n**Reviewer:** AI Code Assistant\n\n---\n\n## Executive Summary\n\nThis is a **well-architected Swift game** built for a child, featuring a waypoint navigation puzzle game with a multi-phase victory sequence. The codebase demonstrates good Swift/SwiftUI practices, proper separation of concerns, and thoughtful error handling.\n\n**Overall Assessment:** ✅ **Good** - Production-ready with some security and polish improvements recommended\n\n**Key Strengths:**\n- Clean MVVM architecture\n- Comprehensive error handling\n- Good use of modern Swift patterns (async/await, Combine)\n- Thoughtful asset loading and caching\n- Complete game mechanics implementation\n\n**Key Concerns:**\n- 🔴 **Security:** API key stored in Info.plist (visible in app bundle)\n- 🟡 **Performance:** Image processing on main thread\n- 🟡 **UX:** Some minor polish items for better kid experience\n\n---\n\n## Architecture Review\n\n### ✅ **Excellent Structure**\n\nThe project follows a clean MVVM pattern with clear separation:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nViews/\n  ├── MainView.swift (main app)\n  ├── WaypointNavigationGame/\n  │   ├── WaypointNavigationView.swift\n  │   ├── WaypointGameCanvas.swift (SpriteKit)\n  │   └── VictorySequenceView.swift\nViewModels/\n  ├── MainViewModel.swift\n  └── WaypointGameViewModel.swift\nModels/\n  └── WaypointGameModels.swift\nServices/\n  ├── APIClient.swift\n  ├── ServerConfig.swift\n  ├── ImageCache.swift\n  ├── AssetsService.swift\n  └── WaypointGameAudioService.swift\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Strengths:**\n- Clear separation of concerns\n- Services are well-organized\n- ViewModels properly manage state\n- Models are simple and focused\n\n### Code Quality\n\n**Swift Best Practices:**\n- ✅ Proper use of &#96;@Published&#96; and &#96;ObservableObject&#96;\n- ✅ Weak references in closures (&#96;[weak self]&#96;)\n- ✅ Proper async/await usage\n- ✅ Good error handling with descriptive messages\n- ✅ Comprehensive logging with emoji prefixes for readability",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# View Mode System - Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\nAdd a view mode selection system that allows switching between different main view layouts. Start with DEFAULT (current) and add a new 4-CAROUSEL mode with style selection.\n\n## Acceptance Criteria\n1. ✅ Default view works unchanged\n2. ✅ View mode selectable from Settings menu\n3. ✅ 4th carousel bottom-aligned with preview drawer\n4. ✅ 4th reference image included in generation when in 4-carousel mode\n5. ✅ GPT prompt modified to use style input\n\n---\n\n## Step-by-Step Implementation Plan\n\n### Phase 1: View Mode Infrastructure (Foundation)\n\n#### Step 1.1: Create View Mode Enum\n**File:** &#96;Models/ViewMode.swift&#96; (NEW)\n- Enum: &#96;ViewMode&#96; with cases:\n  - &#96;.default&#96; (current 3-carousel view)\n  - &#96;.fourCarousel&#96; (new 4-carousel view)\n- Make it &#96;Codable&#96; for persistence\n- Add &#96;displayName: String&#96; computed property\n\n#### Step 1.2: Add View Mode State to MainViewModel\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- Add &#96;@Published var viewMode: ViewMode = .default&#96;\n- Add &#96;@Published var styleIndex: Int = -1&#96; (for 4th carousel)\n- Add &#96;@Published var styleItems: [Ingredient] = []&#96; (placeholder styles)\n- Update &#96;allSelectionsReady&#96; computed property:\n  - Default mode: requires friend, outfit, place (3 selections)\n  - FourCarousel mode: requires friend, outfit, place, style (4 selections)\n\n#### Step 1.3: Persist View Mode Selection\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- Save &#96;viewMode&#96; to UserDefaults on change\n- Load &#96;viewMode&#96; from UserDefaults in &#96;init()&#96;\n- Add &#96;func setViewMode(_ mode: ViewMode)&#96; method\n\n---\n\n### Phase 2: Settings UI (View Selection)\n\n#### Step 2.1: Add View Mode Selector to Settings\n**File:** &#96;Views/Components/SettingsView.swift&#96;\n- Add new section: \"View Mode\" above Music Controls\n- Add &#96;@ObservedObject var viewModel: MainViewModel&#96; parameter\n- Create &#96;ViewModeSelector&#96; component:\n  - Shows current view mode",

        "contents": "//\n//  AssetsService.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Service for discovering and accessing static assets via the Assets API\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport Combine\n\n/// Asset metadata structure matching the API response\nstruct Asset: Codable, Identifiable {\n    let name: String\n    let type: String\n    let url: String\n    let size: Int\n    let mimeType: String\n    let modified: String\n    \n    var id: String { \"\\(type)/\\(name)\" }\n    \n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case name\n        case type\n        case url\n        case size\n        case mimeType = \"mime_type\"\n        case modified\n    }\n}\n\n/// Asset types response\nstruct AssetTypesResponse: Codable {\n    let types: [String]\n    let count: Int\n}\n\n/// Assets by type response\nstruct AssetsByTypeResponse: Codable {\n    let type: String\n    let assets: [Asset]\n    let count: Int\n}\n\n/// All assets response\nstruct AllAssetsResponse: Codable {\n    let assets: [String: [Asset]]\n    let summary: AssetSummary\n}\n\nstruct AssetSummary: Codable {\n    let totalTypes: Int\n    let totalAssets: Int\n    \n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case totalTypes = \"total_types\"\n        case totalAssets = \"total_assets\"\n    }\n}\n\n/// Service for accessing the Assets API\nclass AssetsService: ObservableObject {\n    static let shared = AssetsService()\n    ",

        "contents": "# Server Changes Process - Important Reminder\n\n## ⚠️ CRITICAL: Do Not Make Direct Server Changes\n\n**The server has a very specific build process and CI/CD flow. Direct changes to the server codebase are NOT allowed.**\n\n## Process for Server Changes\n\n### When Client Changes Require Server Updates:\n\n1. **Identify the Need**\n   - If a client-side feature requires server-side changes, document it clearly\n\n2. **Write a Note to Server Team**\n   - Create &#96;NOTE_TO_SERVER_TEAM_FROM_CLIENT.md&#96; in the server project root\n   - Document:\n     - What changes are needed\n     - Why they're needed\n     - Code changes required\n     - Testing recommendations\n     - Impact assessment\n\n3. **Inform the User**\n   - Tell the user (Evan) that server changes are needed\n   - Show them the note you've written\n   - **Let the user decide:**\n     - Ask server team to implement (preferred)\n     - Or approve direct changes if urgent/necessary\n\n4. **Do NOT Make Changes Directly**\n   - Wait for user approval\n   - Wait for server team to review and implement\n   - Or wait for explicit user instruction to proceed\n\n## Example Workflow\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. AI identifies: \"This feature needs server changes\"\n2. AI writes: NOTE_TO_SERVER_TEAM_FROM_CLIENT.md\n3. AI tells user: \"Server changes needed - see note in server project\"\n4. User reviews and decides:\n   - Option A: Send note to server team (preferred)\n   - Option B: Approve direct changes if urgent\n5. AI proceeds based on user decision\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## What Happened This Time\n\n- Client needed style description handling in prompts\n- Changes were made directly to server (not ideal)\n- Note written after the fact to document changes\n- **Going forward:** This process must be followed BEFORE making changes\n\n## Files to Check Before Making Server Changes\n\n- &#96;/Users/evanrobinson/Abbies World Server/&#96; - Server project root\n- Check for existing build/CI documentation\n- Check for server team contact info\n- Review any existing change process documentation\n\n## Remember\n\n✅ **DO:**\n- Write notes documenting needed changes\n- Inform user of server change requirements\n- Wait for user approval/decision",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "        var referenceImageIds: [String] = []\n        \n        func extractAssetPath(from urlString: String?) -&gt; String? {\n            guard let urlString = urlString, !urlString.isEmpty else { return nil }\n            \n            // If it's already a path starting with /static/assets/, use it as-is\n            if urlString.hasPrefix(\"/static/assets/\") {\n                return urlString\n            }\n            \n            // If it's a full URL (http://...), extract the path\n            if urlString.hasPrefix(\"http://\") || urlString.hasPrefix(\"https://\") {\n                if let url = URL(string: urlString) {\n                    return url.path\n                }\n            }\n            \n            // If it doesn't start with /, it's probably a relative path - add prefix\n            if !urlString.hasPrefix(\"/\") {\n                return \"/static/assets/\\(urlString)\"\n            }\n            \n            return urlString\n        }\n        \n        // Extract asset paths from each selected ingredient\n        if let friendPath = extractAssetPath(from: friend.imageURL) {\n            referenceImageIds.append(friendPath)\n        } else {\n            print(\"⚠️ WARNING: Could not extract asset path from friend imageURL: \\(friend.imageURL ?? \"nil\")\")\n        }\n        \n        if let outfitPath = extractAssetPath(from: outfit.imageURL) {\n            referenceImageIds.append(outfitPath)\n        } else {\n            print(\"⚠️ WARNING: Could not extract asset path from outfit imageURL: \\(outfit.imageURL ??         "contents": "struct PolaroidView: View {\n    let image: UIImage\n    let index: Int\n    let isVisible: Bool\n    let currentIndex: Int\n    let totalCount: Int\n    \n    private var offset: PolaroidOffset {\n        let polaroidOffset = (index - currentIndex + totalCount) % totalCount\n        let stackOffset = min(polaroidOffset, 5)\n        \n        return PolaroidOffset(\n            x: Double(stackOffset * 5),\n            y: Double(stackOffset * 3),\n            scale: 1.0 - Double(stackOffset) * 0.05,\n            rotation: Double(stackOffset * 2),\n            opacity: max(0.3, 1.0 - Double(stackOffset) * 0.15),\n            zIndex: 100 - Double(polaroidOffset)\n        )\n    }\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        Image(uiImage: image)\n            .resizable()\n            .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fit)\n            .frame(width: 600, height: 600)\n            .border(Color.white, width: 8)\n            .background(Color.white)\n            .padding(.bottom, 40) // Polaroid frame effect\n            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.8), radius: 16)\n            .offset(x: isVisible ? offset.x : 0, y: isVisible ? offset.y : -100)\n            .scaleEffect(isVisible ? offset.scale : 0.3)\n            .rotationEffect(.degrees(isVisible ? offset.rotation : 180))\n            .opacity(isVisible ? offset.opacity : 0)\n            .zIndex(offset.zIndex)\n            .animation(isVisible ? .spring(response: 1.2, dampingFraction: 0.4) : nil, value: isVisible)\n            .animation(.spring(response: 0.5, dampingFraction: 0.8), value: currentIndex)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct PolaroidOffset: Equatable {\n    let x: Double\n    let y: Double\n    let scale: Double\n    let rotation: Double\n    let opacity: Double\n    let zIndex: Double\n    \n    static func == (lhs: PolaroidOffset, rhs: PolaroidOffset) -&gt; Bool {\n        lhs.x == rhs.x &amp;&amp; lhs.y == rhs.y &amp;&amp; lhs.scale == rhs.scale &amp;&amp;\n        lhs.rotation == rhs.rotation &amp;&amp; lhs.opacity == rhs.opacity &amp;&amp; lhs.zIndex == rhs.zIndex\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "//\n//  SlotView.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/9/25.\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct SlotView: View {\n    let slotType: String\n    let slotIndex: Int\n    @Binding var selectedIngredient: Ingredient?\n    let onDrop: (Ingredient) -&gt; Void\n    @State private var slotImage: UIImage?\n    @State private var isLoadingImage = false\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        ZStack {\n            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8)\n                .strokeBorder(style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 2, dash: [5]))\n                .foregroundColor(.black)\n            \n            if let ingredient = selectedIngredient {\n                VStack(spacing: 8) {\n                    // Image or placeholder\n                    if let image = slotImage {\n                        Image(uiImage: image)\n                            .resizable()\n                            .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fit)\n                            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)\n                            .padding(8)\n                    } else if isLoadingImage {\n                        ProgressView()\n                            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)\n                    } else {\n                        // Fallback to text\n                        Text(ingredient.name)\n                            .font(.system(size: 12))\n                            .multilineTextAlignment(.center)\n                            .padding()\n                    }\n                }\n            } else {\n                Text(\"Slot \\(slotIndex + 1) — \\(slotType)\")\n                    .font(.system(size: 14))\n                    .foregroundColor(.gray)\n            }\n        }\n        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)\n        .contentShape(Rectangle())\n        .onTapGesture {\n            // Clear the slot when tapped\n            if selectedIngredient != nil {\n                selectedIngredient = nil\n            }\n        }\n        .onChange(of: selectedIngredient) { oldValue, newValue in\n            loadImage(for: newValue)\n        }\n    }\n    ",

1.0 : 0.6)\n                .frame(width: 128, height: 128, alignment: .bottomTrailing)\n                .padding(.trailing, 24)\n                .padding(.bottom, 24)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private var videoName: String {\n        switch state {\n        case .notReady:\n            return \"robot_waving_white_background\"\n        case .ready:\n            return \"robot_paint_brush_waving\"\n        case .generating:\n            return \"robot_running_treadmill\"\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private var isReady: Bool {\n        switch state {\n        case .ready, .generating:\n            return true\n        default:\n            return false\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    ZStack {\n        Color.gray.opacity(0.2)",

String ?? \"Unknown error\"\n                print(\"❌ Image generation error from server: \\(message)\")\n                self.handleImageGenerationError(NSError(domain: \"ImageGeneration\", code: -1, userInfo: [NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: message]))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func addImageToHistory(imageURL: String, prompt: String?) {\n        // Extract filename from URL (e.g., \"/static/generated/image_id.png\" -&gt; \"image_id.png\")\n        let filename = imageURL.split(separator: \"/\").last ?? \"unknown.png\"\n        \n        // Create new GeneratedImage (prepend to history for LIFO)\n        let newImage = GeneratedImage(\n            url: imageURL,\n            filename: String(filename),\n            createdAt: Date().timeIntervalSince1970,\n            prompt: prompt,\n            recipeItems: nil,\n            deleted: false\n        )\n        \n        // Prepend to history (LIFO - newest first)\n        historyImages.insert(newImage, at: 0)\n        print(\"📸 Added new image to history: \\(filename) (total: \\(historyImages.count))\")\n        \n        // Also reload from server after a short delay to ensure we have the latest data\n        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 1.0) { [weak self] in\n            self?.loadHistory()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func finishImageGeneration() {\n        // Reset state\n        isCreatingImage = false\n        buttonState = .notReady\n        \n        // Deselect all carousels\n        friendIndex = -1\n        outfitIndex = -1\n        placeIndex = -1\n        \n        print(\"🎉 Image generation complete, carousels reset\")\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Error Handling\n    \n    private func handleImageGenerationError(_ error: Error) {\n        // Reset generation state\n        isCreatingImage = false",

        "contents": "    private func processBuggyImage(_ image: UIImage) -&gt; UIImage? {\n        guard let cgImage = image.cgImage else { return image }\n        \n        let width = cgImage.width\n        let height = cgImage.height\n        let colorSpace = CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB()\n        let bytesPerPixel = 4\n        let bytesPerRow = bytesPerPixel * width\n        let bitsPerComponent = 8\n        \n        guard let context = CGContext(\n            data: nil,\n            width: width,\n            height: height,\n            bitsPerComponent: bitsPerComponent,\n            bytesPerRow: bytesPerRow,\n            space: colorSpace,\n            bitmapInfo: CGImageAlphaInfo.premultipliedLast.rawValue\n        ) else {\n            return image\n        }\n        \n        context.draw(cgImage, in: CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: width, height: height))\n        \n        guard let pixelData = context.data else { return image }\n        let data = pixelData.assumingMemoryBound(to: UInt8.self)\n        \n        // Get top-left pixel color (background color to remove)\n        let bgR = Int(data[0])\n        let bgG = Int(data[1])\n        let bgB = Int(data[2])\n        \n        // Make matching pixels transparent (within 30 RGB tolerance)\n        for y in 0..&lt;height {\n            for x in 0..&lt;width {\n                let pixelIndex = (y * width + x) * bytesPerPixel\n                let r = Int(data[pixelIndex])\n                let g = Int(data[pixelIndex + 1])\n                let b = Int(data[pixelIndex + 2])\n                \n                if abs(r - bgR) &lt;         "contents": "### Phase 5: Generation Integration (4th Reference Image)\n\n#### Step 5.1: Update startImageGeneration() Logic\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- In &#96;startImageGeneration()&#96;:\n  - Check &#96;viewMode&#96;\n  - If &#96;.fourCarousel&#96;:\n    - Require &#96;styleIndex &gt;= 0&#96;\n    - Get selected style ingredient\n    - Add style reference image to &#96;referenceImageIds&#96; array\n  - If &#96;.default&#96;:\n    - Use existing 3-image logic (unchanged)\n\n#### Step 5.2: Handle Style Reference Image\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- For placeholder styles (no actual image):\n  - Option A: Skip 4th reference image (just use style name in prompt)\n  - Option B: Create a placeholder image asset for each style\n  - **Recommendation:** Start with Option A (simpler), add images later if needed\n\n---\n\n### Phase 6: Prompt Modification (Style Integration)\n\n#### Step 6.1: Update Server-Side Prompt Generation\n**File:** &#96;Abbies World Server/src/game_engine.py&#96;\n- Check if 4th reference image is provided\n- If yes, extract style name from image path or metadata\n- Modify prompt generation to include style instruction:\n  - Example: \"Render in [STYLE] style: [generated prompt]\"\n  - Or: \"Using [STYLE] medium, create: [generated prompt]\"\n\n#### Step 6.2: Alternative: Client-Side Style Prompt\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96; (if server doesn't support)\n- If style selected, add to &#96;freeTextDescription&#96;:\n  - Example: \"Style: Crayon\" or \"Medium: Watercolor\"\n- Server will include this in prompt generation\n\n**Recommendation:** Start with client-side approach (simpler), move to server-side later if needed.\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Order (Do One Step at a Time)\n\n1. ✅ **Phase 1** - View mode infrastructure (enum, state, persistence)\n2. ✅ **Phase 2** - Settings UI (view selector)\n3. ✅ **Phase 3** - Style carousel data (placeholder ingredients)\n4. ✅ **Phase 4** - New view layout (FourCarouselView)\n5. ✅ **Phase 5** - Generation integration (4th reference image)\n6. ✅ **Phase 6** - Prompt modification (style in prompt)\n\n---",

        "contents": "//\n//  WaypointGameCanvas.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Created for Waypoint Navigation Minigame\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\nimport SpriteKit\nimport UIKit\n\nstruct WaypointGameCanvas: UIViewRepresentable {\n    @ObservedObject var viewModel: WaypointGameViewModel\n    \n    func makeUIView(context: Context) -&gt; SKView {\n        let view = SKView()\n        view.preferredFramesPerSecond = 60\n        view.ignoresSiblingOrder = true\n        \n        let scene = WaypointGameScene(viewModel: viewModel)\n        scene.scaleMode = .aspectFit\n        scene.backgroundColor = .clear\n        \n        view.presentScene(scene)\n        \n        return view\n    }\n    \n    func updateUIView(_ uiView: SKView, context: Context) {\n        // Update scene if needed\n    }\n}\n\nclass WaypointGameScene: SKScene {\n    weak var gameViewModel: WaypointGameViewModel?\n    \n    private var buggyNode: SKSpriteNode?\n    private var moonbaseNode: SKSpriteNode?\n    private var waypointNodes: [SKShapeNode] = []\n    private var pathNode: SKShapeNode?\n    \n    init(viewModel: WaypointGameViewModel) {\n        self.gameViewModel = viewModel\n        super.init(size: CGSize(width: 860, height: 500))\n    }\n    \n    required init?(coder aDecoder: NSCoder) {\n        fatalError(\"init(coder:) has not been implemented\")\n    }\n    \n    override func didMove(to view: SKView) {\n        setupScene()\n    }\n    \n    private func setupScene() {\n        // Draw stars background\n        drawStars()\n        \n        // Setup path node\n        pathNode = SKShapeNode()\n        pathNode?.strokeColor = .green\n        pathNode?.lineWidth = 3\n        pathNode?.lineCap = .round\n        pathNode?.lineJoin = .round\n        pathNode?.zPosition = 1\n        addChild(pathNode!)\n        \n        // Setup waypoint nodes\n        updateWaypoints()\n        \n        // Setup buggy\n        updateBuggy()\n        \n        // Setup moonbase\n        updateMoonbase()\n    }\n    \n    private func drawStars() {\n        for i in 0..&lt;50 {\n            let x = CGFloat((i * 137) % Int(size.width))",
